g.title: Full shot. The docks at dusk. Alice, centre; Pip, centre, looking at Alice. Pip: Is that our boat? Alice: Not yet.
Cowboy shot. The docks at dusk. Pip, centre, waving, happy. Pip: Hello, boat!
Cowboy shot. The docks at dusk. Pip, centre, arms up, surprised. Pip: It's enormous!
Cowboy shot. The docks at dusk. Pip, centre, scared. Pip, whispering: And so loud.
Full shot. The docks at dusk. Alice, centre, happy; Pip, centre, sad, looking at Alice. Pip: It's going without us. Alice: That one wasn't ours.
